profile.org_note: Family-owned, single-state builder run by owner and CEO Clark Ivory; the company calls itself local and family-owned and publishes no leadership page. Land is bought, entitled and platted by the affiliated Ivory Development, LLC (president Chris Gamvroulas), which is the land decision-maker to call on; finance sits with the CFO (last publicly named in 2021) and the owner. Homebuilding runs through area offices in Salt Lake City, Farmington, Lehi and St. George. Sister businesses: ICO Companies / Ivory Commercial (apartments and commercial), Ivory Innovations (housing-affordability foundation). The registered legal entity name was not confirmed (a directory listing seen only in a search result uses 'Ivory Homes, Ltd.').
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale homebuilder, privately owned by the Ivory family and building only in Utah (seven county areas, 48 model homes); it calls itself Utah's number one homebuilder. It is unusually land-heavy: its November 2026 Ivory Institute deck reports 20,548 lots owned or controlled across Utah and $162M invested in new land and lots in 2026, against roughly 1,000 closings a year. Land comes through its own affiliate, Ivory Development, and through partnerships with landowners rather than any publicly named land banker.
